pr_title: Add support for parameterized link modes
pr_body:
Allows the user to select between clone, hardlink, and copy semantics for installs. (The pnpm documentation has a decent description of what these mean: https://pnpm.io/npmrc#package-import-method.)

Closes #159.

issue_context.title: Add support for copying and hard-linking packages
issue_context.body: By default, we should use whatever's best on the current platform (probably: clone), but we likely want this to be parameterizable to some degree.

review_comments: What does this do on non-reflink platforms?
